title: Will the Federal Reserve Hike rates by 25bps at their December 2026 meeting?
html:
Market · Kalshi

Will the Federal Reserve Hike rates by 25bps at their December 2026 meeting?

Open
Midpoint91.5¢BookYes bid 91¢ · Ask 92¢Depth$12,099ClosesDec 9, 2026Settled byFederal Reserve (https://www.federalreserve.gov)

Asks

  • The Fed raises by a quarter point on December 9
Rules

If the Federal Reserve does a Hike of 25bps on December 09, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

The outcomes are mutually exclusive: at most one can resolve to Yes. For example, a 50-basis-point hike resolves “Hike 25 bps” to Yes and “Hike 25 bps” to No.

If the scheduled FOMC meeting is canceled and does not occur on its scheduled date, “Fed maintains rate” resolves to Yes and all other outcomes resolve to No.
